details: The New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) has selected Avalanche as the blockchain to settle tokenized stocks on its upcoming 24/7 trading platform. This initiative, aiming for a Q4 launch pending regulatory approval, will utilize Avalanche's speed and throughput to support a controlled network with compliance requirements, and is expected to offer instant settlement and fractional shares. AVAX saw a significant rally following the announcement.
title: Avalanche Partners with NYSE for Tokenized Stock Platform

details: The U.S. Treasury's Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) has issued an order prohibiting American financial institutions from engaging in transactions with cryptocurrency exchange MEXC, alleging the platform facilitated approximately $16 billion in illicit finance linked to sanctioned entities in Iran, North Korea, and Russia. Following this, Binance announced it would reject outgoing transfers directly or indirectly linked to MEXC and its affiliates, while holding incoming funds for review.
title: FinCEN Targets MEXC; Binance Halts Related Transfers

details: While Bitcoin and Ethereum experienced declines, the Pepe memecoin surged by approximately 7% in the last 24 hours, driven by speculative rotation and elevated social media buzz. It was highlighted as one of the few cryptocurrencies "swimming against the tide" and attracting short-term momentum traders.
title: Pepe Memecoin Surges as Broader Market Dips

details: The cryptocurrency market experienced significant liquidations totaling over $275 million in the last 24 hours, with approximately $176 million from bullish long positions. Bitcoin and Ethereum prices also saw declines, with Ethereum facing substantial liquidations of $432 million over November 8-9, contributing to its price drop.
title: Crypto Market Sees Over $275M Liquidations as BTC & ETH Fall

details: Despite recent price drops and market liquidations, data indicates that retail and whale derivatives traders on Binance have remained net long on Bitcoin, signaling a firmly bullish sentiment among these cohorts. On-chain analytics also noted an increase in Bitcoin's open interest over the last 24 hours, suggesting underlying demand and accumulation during the sell-off.
title: Bitcoin Whale Sentiment Remains Bullish Despite Price Fluctuations
